title: Goose toolchain pin is 13 days old, one day short of rule 2.11's 14-day minimum
what: Goose v2026.3 was pinned on 2026-11-03, but it was published 2026-10-21, making it 13 days old — one day short of the 14-day minimum required by rule 2.11.
why: The human asked for this version directly in the session on 2026-11-03 (DECISIONS.md D-14-GOOSE). PLAN.md D-14 and 14.2 require a human decision for the switch, and that is what the DECISIONS.md entry records.
impact: The pin is an exception recorded in DECISIONS.md. Re-check the pin after 2026-11-04.
workaround: None needed — human explicitly requested this version. Exception recorded in DECISIONS.md.
